text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A product promotion offer came in for 
Hokko Tarumae. The product, which has ties 
to Tomakomai, is—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
What you want to say, what you want to 
turn into words and images♪ On a pure 
white, smooth canvas! Let's print♪ Copy, 
copy♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
How about some printer paper, everyone?! 
High-quality, low-cost printer paper is on 
sale right now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, copy paper. Since it's made by a 
paper mill in Tomakomai, she was quite 
enthusiastic about it, but—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"We wanna be kind to you, cheap and easy 
to use♪ Running costs kept to the minimum! 
Let's print♪ Copy, copy♪"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hey, ladies over there! Copy paper's on 
sale~! Care to take a look?

text_block_list.name: Passing Woman A
text_block_list.text: Ah, no thanks... I'm good for now...

text_block_list.name: Passing Woman B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, the song is cute and all... but why 
copy paper? People don't just buy that on 
a whim on the street, right...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've been singing for about an hour now, 
but not a single person has stopped to 
listen. In fact, people are actually 
keeping their distance...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Hello there, mister! Let's print♪ Copy, 
copy♪ Would your company like some copy 
paper?!"

text_block_list.name: Passing Man
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, well... I can't really decide 
something like that. Sorry~..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I'll count on ya next time, 
then...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. Yeah, not done yet...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Would ya like some copy paper~! It's... 
on sale right now, y'all...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae undauntedly continued her PR 
with a smile. However... signs of fatigue 
showed from having sung non-stop.
choice_data_list: Tarumae, let's take a short break.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. They won't sell that easily, huh. 
I need to put more thought into this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, selling copy paper on the 
street is tough. Constantly doing a job 
with no results to show for it... gotta be 
exhausting, right?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —I'll be fine. Really.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, it might look a bit strange. 
Promoting copy paper, that is.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
But... if it helps liven up Tomakomai, 
then I want to do my best.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It is no exaggeration to say that the 
paper manufacturing industry, which began 
in the Meiji era, was one of the key 
catalysts for Tomakomai's prosperity.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
They still produce plenty of high-quality 
paper even now, supporting everyone's 
daily lives in society— just like this 
copy paper here.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I want to properly convey Tomakomai's 
history and strengths like that, one by 
one.

text_block_list.name: Local
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for today too! Tarumae-chan's 
stage was a huge hit, ya know! Customer 
turnout's up, so everything's just 
peachy!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm glad if I could help out even a 
little! I'll push even harder to keep 
bringing in more customers!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—The local idol Hokko Tarumae costume I've 
been wearing since back then.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I had this racing attire made with the 
exact same design."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
My pledge as a local idol, and the hopes 
of everyone back home—they're all riding 
on this. ...So as long as I'm wearing 
this, I'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I can still sing—I'll show you I can sell 
them!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then what I can do— is help ensure that 
each and every job goes as smoothly as 
possible.
choice_data_list: Let's show everyone all those feelings!
Let's rethink how we sell it!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: My feelings... to everyone...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Um! I'm going to try writing the next 
part of the lyrics for this song on the 
copy paper!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
They listened to my song, so... I thought 
maybe through singing, I could convey my 
feelings!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Copy paper on sale! I'm Hokko Tarumae, 
the local idol from Tomakomai♪"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, please listen! 'Tomakomai: 
The Copy Paper Song'!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Did you know it's actually eco-friendly? 
Supporting society, made in Tomakomai, 
high quality♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Tomakomai's pride: our paper 
manufacturing♪ Ever since way back in the 
Meiji era, we've innovated and grown! I 
want to deliver that dedication right into 
your hands!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "Let's print♪ Copy, copy♪"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—It's high-quality copy paper born in 
resource-rich Tomakomai, dontcha know!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
A sincere, ambitious factory developed 
this paper through steady, persistent 
effort, ya know! Go on, feel free to pick 
it up and try it out~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap... clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Passing Spectators
text_block_list.text:
It was amazing~! Paper made in Tomakomai 
really is incredible!

text_block_list.name: Salaryman-like Man
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to use that copy paper at our 
company too...! I'll go talk to my boss 
about it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, her passionate feelings reached 
the people, turning the copy paper PR into 
a massive success!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: How to sell it, you say...?
choice_data_list: What are the selling points of this paper?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The main points are that it's durable and 
versatile, but—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I see! If we can highlight that, maybe the 
audience will take an interest...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's start the papercraft 
workshop now, ya hear♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"We're gonna make flowers out of printer 
paper! Cut the paper into petals, fold 'em 
in half, and...!"

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay! ...Huh? It's not splitting in 
half... Like this? Or this?

text_block_list.name: Child's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if you crumple and fold it like that, 
the paper's going to rip—

text_block_list.name: Child's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Wait, oh? Seems to be fine... This paper 
is very sturdy.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's right! With sturdy, easy-to-use 
Tomakomai-made copy paper, we can do all 
the crafts we want♪

text_block_list.name: Child's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Huh, this looks great for arts and crafts 
homework too. Maybe I should buy one to 
take home." his

text_block_list.name: Passing Parent and Child
text_block_list.text:
—Mommy~, look, that looks fun! —Oh my, 
you're right. What could that be?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, intrigued parents and children 
flocked over one after another, 
successfully boosting sales.
